considered_lineage.mechanism_question: Can the 30-day mean of Bitcoin active addresses divided by current Bitcoin market capitalization identify a low-complexity weekly BTC long-or-cash value state?

primary_and_adversarial_prior.identity: Liebi, Is there a value premium in cryptoasset markets?, Economic Modelling 109, 2022, DOI 10.1016/j.econmod.2022.105777
primary_and_adversarial_prior.finding: The paper defines aanv30 as average active addresses over the previous 30 days divided by current market capitalization and reports a value premium from weekly cross-sectional sorts across 652 cryptoassets.
primary_and_adversarial_prior.transfer_boundary: The paper does not specify a BTC-only rolling lookback, absolute threshold, own-history quantile, binary cash action or matched-capital BTC timing comparator. Its high and low states exist only relative to other assets in the same weekly cross-section.

primary_and_adversarial_prior.identity: Liebi 2021 open manuscript adversarial measurement discussion
primary_and_adversarial_prior.finding: The manuscript states that one user may own multiple active addresses and documents sensitivity of active-address and transaction measures to mixer activity. It uses proprietary data under a nondisclosure agreement and cross-sectional winsorization.
primary_and_adversarial_prior.transfer_boundary: A free Coin Metrics BTC series would be a provider-and-universe translation, not a direct replication of the paper's proprietary multi-asset panel.

closed_family_deduplication.boundary: The AdrActCnt axis and its next-week BTC outcomes are already known. Its frozen active-address-only neighbor was identical to the failed primary in Validation, with only 15.402117% upside capture and Calmar at 17.464393% of buy-and-hold. Adding market-cap normalization now would be outcome-aware feature engineering on a closed primitive.
The same active-address flow has also failed an independently matched-capital DRA admission audit, so a renamed ratio cannot reopen that entry-filter lineage.

A BTC-only own-history market-cap-relative valuation state has already reached a terminal economic decision. AANV30 is not MVRV, but inventing another own-history threshold after the cross-sectional source does not supply one would repeat the same unsupported timing translation.
The nearest network-utility-to-market-value family is already closed under its exact free-source contract. AANV30 cannot be presented as an NVT source substitution or rescue.

why_no_hypothesis: The primary evidence is cross-sectional: high and low AANV30 are defined by contemporaneous ranks among many assets, not by whether BTC is high relative to its own past.
A BTC-only trailing median, quintile, z-score or absolute threshold would have to be selected by this research program; none is fixed by the source.

The historical BTC return behavior of the active-address primitive is already known from two closed audits, so adding current market capitalization and selecting a time-series threshold would be outcome-aware neighboring-feature construction.

The proprietary 652-asset panel, weekly cross-sectional availability, survivorship treatment and winsorization cannot be reproduced by the existing free single-BTC corpus without materially changing the design.

The only faithful test would require a broad point-in-time multi-asset on-chain panel. That is outside the current free-data, low-cost, single-BTC execution path and is not the fastest credible route to a strategy.
missing_proof: No primary source fixes a single-BTC own-history AANV30 threshold, direction-conditioned cash action and holding horizon.
No free point-in-time 652-asset-equivalent active-address and market-cap panel with survivorship and revision controls is bound.
No AANV30 value, BTC outcome, factor support, hypothesis, manifest, runner, economics, candidate, OOS or forward evidence was accessed or computed.
prohibited_reopen: Do not scan BTC-only AANV30 medians, quantiles, z-scores, lookbacks, weekdays, directions, cash weights or holding periods on the existing historical outcomes.
Do not add market-cap normalization to the closed active-address activity families or relabel MVRV, NVT or active-address growth as AANV value timing.
Do not substitute a present-vintage single-BTC Coin Metrics series for the paper's proprietary multi-asset cross-section and call it a replication.
Do not open post-2024 or OOS evidence for this rejected no-hypothesis lineage.
material_learning: A published cross-sectional factor is not automatically a single-asset timing signal. AANV30 may rank cryptoassets by relative value, but converting that rank into a BTC own-history threshold requires a new model choice. Because the active-address primitive's BTC outcomes are already known, making that choice now would be data-dependent feature engineering rather than an independent preregistration.
